gloss: first thing in the afternoon; 1 PM; right after lunch

definitions.gloss: first thing in the afternoon; right after lunch
definitions.explanation: the earliest time slot in the afternoon, typically meaning 1 PM or immediately after the lunch break

examples.japanese: {午後一|ごごいち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a meeting first thing in the afternoon.

examples.japanese: {午後一|ごごいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ→打ち合わせ：07155_uchiawase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: I'll be back in time for the 1 PM meeting.

examples.japanese: {昼休|ひるやす}み{明|あ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{午後一|ごごいち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}く→眠い：00872_nemui⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧がちだ。
examples.english: You tend to get sleepy right after lunch when the afternoon starts.

notes:
Colloquial abbreviation of ⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧ (first thing in the afternoon). Very common in workplace Japanese for scheduling. The ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ here means "first" (as in the first slot), not literally 1 o'clock, though in practice it usually means around 1 PM or 13:00. Follows the same pattern as {朝一|あさいち} (first thing in the morning).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {午後一|ごごいち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: first thing in the afternoon
- {午後一|ごごいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: afternoon's first meeting
- {午後一|ごごいち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to start in the early afternoon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {朝一|あさいち}: first thing in the morning — the same pattern for the morning
- ⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧: first thing in the afternoon — the full, unabbreviated form
- ⟦{昼過|ひるす}ぎ→昼過ぎ：12966_hirusugi⟧: early afternoon — a more general term for after noon
